description: Figure 2, located on the left side of the page, is a bar chart titled "NDCG@10" that presents the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. The chart compares the performance of a system with all components against versions where specific components are removed. The horizontal axis displays four categories: "Ours" (representing the full system), "critiquing" (with attribute-based item critiquing removed), "scoring" (with generative item scoring removed), and "ranking" (with efficient candidate ranking removed). The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25. The bar for "Ours" is the tallest, indicating the highest performance at approximately 0.22. The bar for "critiquing" is the second tallest, at about 0.19. The bar for "ranking" is the third, at approximately 0.12. The bar for "scoring" is the shortest, at about 0.07. The caption clarifies that "critiquing" refers to attribute-based item critiquing, "scoring" refers to generative item scoring, and "ranking" refers to efficient candidate ranking. The visual data shows that removing the "scoring" component results in the most significant drop in performance, followed by the removal of "ranking" and then "critiquing".
